original_scale_pipeline.first_pass: each child ParticleSystem Transform.localScale XYZ *= screenWidthAdjustRate
original_scale_pipeline.second_pass: the same child ParticleSystem Transform.localScale XYZ *= normalizedNoteSize * ScreenToSafeAreaRatio
original_scale_pipeline.enumeration: GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>(includeInactive=true) under every integer and half GamePlayButton
original_scale_pipeline.mutated_property: each ParticleSystem component own Transform.localScale only
original_scale_pipeline.nested_semantics: every ParticleSystem component in an ancestor chain receives g; child local position is scaled by particle-system ancestors while emitted shape position, velocity and billboard size also consume the emitting system own g
original_scale_pipeline.final_world_semantics: compose each serialized TRS after multiplying that ParticleSystem transform scale by g; do not flatten the completed world sample to one final g

color_pipeline.browser_blending: straight-alpha source with material SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha or SrcAlpha/One in linear target
color_pipeline.browser_output: unpremultiply-linear, linear-to-sRGB encode, repremultiply for final canvas composition

geometry.signed_height: height*lengthScale+speed*velocityScale; abs extent plus independent long-axis/UV sign

mipmap_boundary.disposition: remain explicit portable raster difference until exact lower levels are delivered

simulation_boundaries.expiry_capacity_order: update existing, remove expired, then process chronologically ordered births
simulation_boundaries.pause_difference: freeze particle domain with the engine clock and consume no random/event draws until resume; this intentionally differs from native UI-pause continuation

device_observation.effect_envelope: localized around judged GamePlayButton owners; physical frame is an observation, not a per-pixel portable oracle
